🧹 Clean Up Contractor Names
These look like the same contractor spelled differently across Project Records, QC Projects, NHC Records and Maintenance Survey. Pick the correct spelling for each group, or uncheck a group to leave it alone. Nothing is changed until you click Apply.
🧹 Clean Up Areas
These look like the same area spelled differently in NHC Records. Pick the correct spelling for each group, or uncheck a group to leave it alone. Nothing is changed until you click Apply. If a group is actually different areas (not a spelling issue), click 🚫 Ignore — it won't be suggested again.
🧭 Block / Area Mismatch Check
Same Block No shouldn't normally have more than one Area name. These blocks have records with different areas — pick the correct one for each block, or uncheck a group to leave it alone. Nothing is changed until you click Apply.
🧹 Cleanup Block Names
These block numbers appear with more than one name across the WDD Project Registry and NHC Records. Pick the correct name for each block, or uncheck a group to leave it alone. Applying updates NHC Records' Area field directly and rewrites the block reference inside WDD Project Registry's Area field. Nothing is changed until you click Apply, and this cannot be undone.

🩺 Data Health
Every consistency and completeness check the app runs, in one place — covering records added or edited today or later. Historical data is intentionally excluded to avoid flagging legacy records.
🩺
Click Run Health Check to scan your current data.
📌 Export Target: Project Records (default) (data and columns will match the currently active view)
🗂️ Full Application Backup
One file with everything: Project Records + QC Projects + Utility (part of Project Records) + NHC + Maintenance + Notes + Vacation + Contacts + Reminders + Survey Team (Extra Time Allowances) + the full Activity Log. Block Details is derived live from Project Records & NHC, so it's automatically included too. Before any full restore, the current application data is automatically downloaded as a safety backup. A daily backup also downloads automatically the first time you open the dashboard each day.
Automatic backup to a folder
Select a folder once. The app remembers its folder handle in browser storage and backs up all module data when changes are detected. After reopening, use RECONNECT SAVED FOLDER if the browser needs permission again; this should reuse the saved folder without making you browse for it again. Automatic backups run while this app is open.

Block No
Block Name
✕
Team No
Unique blocks pulled from the WDD Project Registry (Area) and NHC Records (Block No & Area), plus any blocks added manually below. Refreshes automatically as new blocks show up in either module. Tick one or more rows and click ✏️ Edit Selected, use ✏️ Edit Block to pick a single block from a dropdown, ➕ Add Block to register a new block before it has any project/NHC record yet, or 📦 Bulk Update to rename several at once — the Area field is updated in NHC Records (and the matching WDD Project Registry entries) automatically to keep everything in sync. Tick one or more rows and click 🗑️ Delete Selected to remove a block's manual registration and Team assignment — a block still cited by real records isn't deleted outright and will reappear until those records are edited or removed.
SnoBlock No ▲Block Name Team
✏️ Edit Block
Saving updates the Area field on all matching NHC Records (and the equivalent WDD Project Registry entries) for the selected block so both stay in sync.
➕ Add Block
Registers a block ahead of any project/NHC record referencing it - useful for a block that's known/planned but hasn't had a survey or connection logged yet. It'll show up here immediately and get picked up automatically once real records start using it.
📦 Bulk Update Blocks
Tick the blocks you want to rename and edit the Block Name field for each. Nothing is changed until you click Apply — unchecked or unchanged rows are left alone.
